posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-search 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。不用官方 DeepSeek API 也能用内置 web_search：关掉 web-search-deepseek，默认走 Tavily keyless。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0091abbf994fc811701d.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-search is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Keep the built-in web_search tool without an official DeepSeek API key: disable web-search-deepseek and use Tavily keyless by default.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0091abbf994fc811701d.html
